*880This case is set for argument on the exceptions to the report of the Special Master and is assigned for hearing at the end of the call for the week beginning December 5. A total of four hours is allowed for oral argument. The motion of the United States for determination of certain legal points is denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of these questions.
